summary.text: In April 2024 guidance attributed to Veronica E. Hinton, OPM said it was implementing the AI in Government Act of 2020 and releasing AI classification and talent acquisition guidance for agency use and comment. The guidance described an OPM AI occupational study, characterized AI work as multidisciplinary, and allowed “AI” as a parenthetical title for positions performing AI work most of the time. A December 2025 OPM memo attributed to Hinton said OPM had granted governmentwide direct-hire authority for certain IT, cybersecurity, AI, and other technical positions and reminded agencies of HR flexibilities to recruit and retain such employees.
